❌ Legacy SIP Alert-Info Failure Modes (RFC 7462 / RFC 3261)
1. External Ringtone URL SSRF: Alert-Info: <http://169.254.169.254/...>
causes media gateways or softphones to fetch internal IMDS credentials.
2. Silent Auto-Answer Intercom Hijack: Injecting ;info=alert-autoanswer
forces agent turrets off-hook into live mic eavesdropping without consent.
3. Internal-Source Privilege Escalation: External caller injects
urn:alert:source:internal to bypass external IVR identity verification.
Result: Ringtone SSRF + silent mic eavesdropping + auth bypass
✅ Deterministic P995–P996 🎉 (SVG 145 & 1,005 Guards!) Alert-Info Gate
1. P995 (1,004th Guard) Non-Dereferenceable URN & Auto-Answer Strip:
Forbid http(s)/file URIs, strip alert-autoanswer & cap entries in [1, 4].
2. P996 🎉 (🎉 SVG 145 & 1,005th Guard) External Origin Rewrite Lock:
Rewrite external source:internal -> source:external & cap depth ∈ [1, 5].
3. Zero-Trust Trunk Tagging: Stamp origin classification at the ingress
SBC based on authenticated trunk identity rather than caller headers.
Result: 0 ringtone SSRF/auto-answer · 0 source spoofing · depth ∈ [1, 5]
